messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — BlueHarbor renewal is in flight. Procurement needs a PO with vendor code and CFO wants a 6mo term instead of 12. Can we triage pricing + signature path?
Ethan (AE): CFO (J. Park) prefers 6mo and asked for a 20% concession citing integration work. Procurement wants PO now.
Maya (CSM): They used pilot credits last quarter. My initial idea: 6mo at list -10% + one-time onboarding credit. Less than 15% discount shouldn't need exec approval.
Priya (Legal): Quick check — any discount >15% requires Legal + Sales manager signoff. Split-signature flows are ok but need amendment language. Who will sign first?
Ethan (AE): Procurement will sign first (delegated signer), CFO signs commercial terms. CFO is OOO until Wed. Procurement assigned S. Gomez as delegated signer.
Lucas (Finance): Finance can provision if we receive a valid PO with vendor code BH-OP-778 and VAT ID. We prefer a PO + e-sign later, but need invoice entity confirmed.
Maya (CSM): Procurement sent a draft PO — https://files.redwood/blueharbor/po-draft.pdf. I'll confirm VAT ID and ask for delegated authority letter for S. Gomez.
DocuSignBot: ERROR: envelope 0x4a7 failed to deliver to j.park@blueharbor.com — recipient domain blocks external e-sign. (automated retry scheduled) :warning:
Priya (Legal): If DocuSign to CFO fails, options: (1) accept scanned wet-sign with delegation letter, (2) use alternate delegated signer for commercial execution, or (3) use company-approved e-sign vendor. For EU entities wet-sign requires notarization — flagging risk.
Ethan (AE): Customer prefers e-sign but agrees to split-sign flow: procurement (S. Gomez) then CFO for commercial. Can we proceed with that?
Maya (CSM): @Priya can you draft a short amendment that allows split execution and confirms delegated signer authority? Will also ask them to upload PO to our portal.
Priya (Legal): Will draft amendment now. I'll include clause: "Procurement execution does not substitute for final commercial execution; commercial terms effective upon counterparty exec." Link when ready.
Lucas (Finance): Note: billing entity changing to BlueHarbor EMEA on this commit — need VAT id on PO or we'll invoice GBP w/ reverse charge.
Maya (CSM): Request sent to S. Gomez for VAT ID and authority letter. Also flagged vendor code on upload.
Ethan (AE): Timeline constraint: procurement wants invoice issued by Friday. If we have PO + delegated signature by Thursday, can we provision?
Maya (CSM): Should be doable. @DocuSignBot please re-route envelope 0x4a7 to sgomez@blueharbor.com then j.park@blueharbor.com in split order once amendment attached.
DocuSignBot: Retrying: sent envelope 0x4a7 -> recipients: S. Gomez (order 1), J. Park (order 2).
Maya (CSM): Priya — when amendment draft ready, ping here so we can attach to envelope. Lucas — will you confirm finance ok with this partial flow?
Lucas (Finance): Finance approves provisioning on receipt of PO and vendor code. Discount up to 15% is within approval. >15% needs revenue ops signoff.
Ethan (AE): Customer pushing 20%. I propose counter-offer: 10% discount + $4k onboarding credit + 2 months complimentary support. Keeps list discount low but compensates integration effort.
Maya (CSM): Agreed — present options to them. I'll emphasize quicker provisioning if they accept delegated signer + PO now.
S. Gomez (BlueHarbor): I received the DocuSign link and the PO request. I'll sign the procurement part today and upload the PO. Do you need any extra docs?
Maya (CSM): Please upload PO and VAT ID to https://invoices.redwood/upload and include vendor code BH-OP-778. Also attach a short authority letter for your delegation.
S. Gomez (BlueHarbor): Uploaded invoice-9876.pdf and delegation-letter.pdf. Let me know if anything else needed.
DocuSignBot: Envelope 0x4a7 status: S. Gomez signed (2026-03-23T15:42:10Z). Waiting for J. Park.
Priya (Legal): Amendment draft posted: https://redwood.internal/legal/drafts/blueharbor-split-amendment. Review requested — I'll attach to envelope once approved.
Lucas (Finance): Received PO files. VAT ID present. I'll queue billing setup once DocuSign completes procurement signature and amendment attached.
Ethan (AE): I'll hold final quote send until amendment in place. Customer likely to accept 10% + onboarding credit.
Maya (CSM): Closing loop for now — I'll update renewal tracker and DM anyone if CFO signs earlier. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
